metadata.title: Your Brain Is Lying To You (Psychology Facts) #Shorts
metadata.description: Science proves your memories, choices, and instincts quietly deceive you. Which fact broke you? Comment the number. #Shorts #PsychologyFacts #DarkPsychology

audio_profile.recommended_voice_style: deep male authoritative, urgent cinematic undertone
audio_profile.bg_music_vibe: dark cinematic tension strings over low pulsing synth drone

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Your brain is lying to you right now. And science can prove it.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: dark moody portrait half lit face shadow cinematic slow motion
video_pipeline.on_screen_text_overlay: YOUR BRAIN IS LYING TO YOU

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact one. Every memory you replay gets rewritten. Your past is a rough draft.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: vintage film projector reels flickering macro nostalgic warm dust

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact two. Your brain decides before you know. Free will arrives late.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: glowing neural network neurons firing dark blue background macro slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact three. More choices equal less action. Menus paralyze you.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: person overwhelmed many doors corridor symmetrical surreal slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact four. Dopamine isn't pleasure. It's anticipation. The chase is the drug.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: neon city night drive timelapse fast lights motion blur energetic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact five. People notice you far less than you think. Nobody is watching.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: crowded street pedestrians blurred anonymous motion timelapse muted

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact six. A tired brain fabricates memories and fills gaps confidently.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: sleepless person alarm clock night insomnia dim bedroom moody

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Fact seven. Placebos still work. Even when you know they are fake.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: white pills capsules macro clinical laboratory clean minimal slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: So you still trust your gut? Careful. It was never fully yours.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: dark storm clouds swirling ominous timelapse cinematic tension

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Which fact broke you? Comment the number. Follow before your brain forgets.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: abstract glowing question mark particles dark background loop minimal
